svg.title: What the AI Passport coverage establishes
svg.desc: Three bands. Established across outlets: a cryptographically signed credential, coverage of both agents and MCP servers, graduated responses to drift, and NVIDIA as launch partner. Single-source or conflicting: issuance from the control tower, and whether the product is launched or expected in the fourth quarter of 2026. Unestablished: revoking an already-issued passport, and any verifier outside the issuer's own estate.
svg.text: Sort the launch claims by how well they are established.
a signed credential · covers agents and MCP servers
redirect, restrict, deactivate · NVIDIA as launch partner
issued from the control tower, built from existing approvals
availability: described as launched, or expected in Q4 2026
any verifier outside the issuer's own estate
